durable_wakeups.distinction: Inbox request IDs are explicit wakeups/actions. The 30-second runtime poll calls reconciliation directly and does not enqueue an inbox request. Herdr's plugin log has event/time/exit status but no inbox request ID, so this record does not claim a one-to-one mapping between a particular hook log and a particular reconcile request.

duplicate_safety.live_observation: After the deliberately missed chat-exit callback was recovered by timer, three actual pane.agent_status_changed plugin command executions (plugin-log-128 through 130) and reconcile requests 242 through 244 occurred during one recovered-chat startup. Worker run count stayed 21, and the outbox remained 77/77 delivered with no duplicate messages. Herdr does not provide event-instance IDs, so this proves repeated callback executions are idempotent at the observed map level, not exact replay of one same event ID.
